template.CONFIG_FLOW_SCALE_DESC: Resolution used to track motion between frames. Lower is faster and lighter on the GPU; higher gives cleaner generated frames.
template.CONFIG_BASE_FPS_CAP_DESC: Caps the game's own frame rate before frame generation (DXVK games only); 0 disables. A steady cap gives steadier pacing than a fluctuating frame rate. Requires game restart to apply.
template.CONFIG_PERFORMANCE_MODE_DESC: Uses a much lighter frame generation model with a small quality cost. Recommended on handhelds.
template.CONFIG_DISABLE_GAMESCOPE_WSI_DESC: Adds ENABLE_GAMESCOPE_WSI=0 without changing HDR. Requires game restart to apply.
template.CONFIG_DISABLE_STEAMDECK_MODE_DESC: Disables a game-specific Steam Deck compatibility switch. Requires game restart to apply.
template.CONFIG_DISABLE_VKBASALT_DESC: Disables vkBasalt layer which can conflict with LSFG (Reshade, some Decky plugins)
template.CONFIG_ENABLE_ZINK_DESC: Uses Mesa's Zink OpenGL-to-Vulkan driver. May cause crashes or freezes with some games. Requires game restart to apply.
template.CONFIG_BASE_FPS_CAP_OUTPUT: With {multiplier}x frame generation you will see about {fps} FPS.
template.CONFIG_PRESENT_MODE_OVERRIDE_DESC: Forces Vsync (FIFO), which frame pacing needs to stay even. Leave on unless a game misbehaves.
template.CONFIG_PRESERVE_SWAPCHAIN_DESC: Keeps the game's own swapchain size. Turn on only if a Vulkan game crashes on launch; it can make pacing less smooth.
template.PRESET_CUSTOM_DESC: Flow Scale and Performance Mode are set by hand below.
template.PRESET_QUALITY_DESC: Full-resolution motion estimation with the standard model. Fewest warping, bubbling and blur artifacts, heaviest on the GPU.
template.PRESET_BALANCED_DESC: 80% motion estimation with the standard model. A good starting point for most games.
template.PRESET_LOW_LATENCY_DESC: 50% motion estimation with the lighter model. Frames are generated faster, which shortens the delay frame generation adds and saves battery. Slightly softer motion.
template.PACING_TARGET_DESC: Locks the game to a steady frame rate that multiplies exactly onto your screen's refresh rate. This is the best fix for uneven motion, and a steady, lighter load also cuts input lag. Requires game restart to apply.
template.TIPS_DESC: Warping and bubbling: use the Quality preset and a higher base FPS (40+ looks best). Tearing: keep Present Mode Override on. Laggy or uneven: pick a Smooth pacing target in Workarounds and keep the GPU below 100%.
template.CONFIG_DISABLE_HDR_DESC: Prevents DXVK from exposing HDR to the game. Requires game restart to apply.
template.MULTIPLIER_1X_DESC: 1x: no extra frames are generated. Frames pass through lsfg-vk unchanged, which is useful for comparing against 2x or higher.
